# wallix.bastion.application

Manage applications on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.1.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete an application on a WALLIX Bastion.
- An application of category `standard` is a program started on a jump server (a cluster of RDP services); an application of category `web_application` is a web site opened through the Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_application` Terraform resource.
- Local domains of the application are managed with [`wallix.bastion.application_localdomain`](application_localdomain.md).

| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-application-name"></a>**application_name** | `str` / required | Name of the application. Identifies the application on the Bastion. |
| <a id="parameter-application-url"></a>**application_url** | `str` | URL of the application, for the `web_application` and `jumphost` categories.<br>Required when a `web_application` is created. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-browser"></a>**browser** | `str` | Browser used to open the application, for the `jumphost` category. |
| <a id="parameter-browser-version"></a>**browser_version** | `str` | Version of [`browser`](#parameter-browser), for the `jumphost` category. |
| <a id="parameter-category"></a>**category** | `str` | Category of the application. It cannot be changed once the application exists.<br>When the application is created and this option is not set, `standard` is used, as the Terraform provider does.<br>`jumphost` is only accepted by Bastion API versions older than v3.12, which replaced it with `web_application`.<br><br>Choices: `standard`, `jumphost`, `web_application` |
| <a id="parameter-connection-policy"></a>**connection_policy** | `str` | Name of the connection policy of the application, for example `RDP` for a `standard` application or `WEBAPP` for a `web_application`.<br>Required when the application does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-description"></a>**description** | `str` | Description of the application. |
| <a id="parameter-global-domains"></a>**global_domains** | `list / elements=str` | Names of the global domains whose accounts can be used on the application. Order does not matter.<br>When set, replaces all the global domains of the application. Use `[]` to remove them all. |
| <a id="parameter-login-button-selector"></a>**login_button_selector** | `str`<br>*added in 1.2.0* | CSS selector of the submit button of the login form, for the `web_application` category.<br>Use `""` to remove it.<br>Not in the `wallix-bastion_application` Terraform resource. |
| <a id="parameter-login-form-url"></a>**login_form_url** | `str`<br>*added in 1.2.0* | URL of the login form the Bastion fills in with the account credentials, for the `web_application` category, when it differs from [`application_url`](#parameter-application-url).<br>Use `""` to remove it.<br>Not in the `wallix-bastion_application` Terraform resource. |
| <a id="parameter-parameters"></a>**parameters** | `str` | Command line parameters of the program, for the `standard` category. |
| <a id="parameter-paths"></a>**paths** | `list / elements=dict` | Program started on the jump server, for the `standard` category.<br>Required when a `standard` application is created. The Bastion accepts a single path.<br>When set, replaces the path of the application. It cannot be removed. |
| <a id="parameter-paths-program"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **program** | `str` / required | Path of the program on the jump server. |
| <a id="parameter-paths-target"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **target** | `str` / required | Service of the jump server the program runs on, as `Interactive@<device>:<service>`. |
| <a id="parameter-paths-working-dir"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **working_dir** | `str` | Working directory of the program. An unset value means no working directory. |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the application should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-tags"></a>**tags** | `list / elements=dict` | Tags of the application. Order does not matter.<br>When set, replaces all the tags of the application. Use `[]` to remove all tags. |
| <a id="parameter-tags-key"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **key** | `str` / required | Tag key. |
| <a id="parameter-tags-value"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **value** | `str` / required | Tag value. |
| <a id="parameter-target"></a>**target** | `str` | Name of the cluster of jump servers the application runs on, for the `standard` category.<br>Required when a `standard` application is created. |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- The Bastion refuses to delete an application that still has local domain accounts. Remove them first with [`wallix.bastion.application_localdomain_account`](application_localdomain_account.md).
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Publish a program of a Windows jump server
  wallix.bastion.application:
    application_name: erp-client
    connection_policy: RDP
    category: standard
    target: jump-servers
    paths:
      - target: Interactive@win-jump-01:RDP
        program: C:\Program Files\ERP\erp.exe
        working_dir: C:\Program Files\ERP
    parameters: --server erp.example.com
    global_domains: [corp.local]

- name: Publish a web application
  wallix.bastion.application:
    application_name: intranet
    connection_policy: WEBAPP
    category: web_application
    application_url: https://intranet.example.com/login
    login_form_url: https://intranet.example.com/sso/login
    login_button_selector: "#login-submit"
    allow_non_post_form: false
    tags:
      - key: env
        value: prod

- name: Remove an application
  wallix.bastion.application:
    application_name: intranet
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-application"></a>**application** | `dict` | The application as returned by the Bastion API after the change.<br>In check mode, the expected application. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-application) |
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated.<br><br>Returned: when the application already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["paths", "tags"]` |

<a id="sample-application"></a>

### Sample of `application`

```yaml
application_name: erp-client
category: standard
cluster: jump-servers
connection_policy: RDP
description: ''
global_domains:
- corp.local
id: 1a0f768b7518980c005056b66c8b
last_connection: null
local_domains: []
parameters: --server erp.example.com
paths:
- program: C:\Program Files\ERP\erp.exe
  target: Interactive@win-jump-01:RDP
  working_dir: C:\Program Files\ERP
tags: []
target: jump-servers
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/applications/1a0f768b7518980c005056b66c8b
```
